package.name: gui
package.description: Tkinter control panel for starting/stopping megadog_description's Gazebo sim and RViz (OCS2 desired/optimized trajectory + contact markers from megadog_wbc), and clearing leftover gz/ros processes, instead of juggling several terminals by hand. Ported from babyDog's gui package, trimmed to Sim/RViz/Kill/Shutdown - megaDog has no FSM command message, joystick_bridge, or real-hardware backend yet.
